verdict.rationale: Any service that holds user data could plausibly state whether that data is used for AI training, so this axis applies to the Ohio Secretary of State's filing services. The evidence offers only a generic statement that OHID logins are protected by federal and state digital security standards. It includes no AI-training policy, opt-out, or data-use commitment. The robots.txt 403 probes concern crawler access to the sites, not whether user data is withheld from AI training.
